name: beego
description_en: beego is an open-source, high-performance web framework for the Go programming language.
readme_excerpt: Beego Beego is used for rapid development of enterprise application in Go, including RESTful APIs, web apps and backend services. It is inspired by Tornado, Sinatra and Flask. beego has some Go-specific features such as interfaces and struct embedding.
